summary: Exercise Talon Storm: multiple helicopters conducting low-level tactical training within 8 nautical miles of Netheravon, between 200 and 5,000 feet.
text:
EXER TALON STORM. MULTIPLE HEL OPR LOW LEVEL CONDUCTING TACTICAL 
TRAINING WI 8NM RADIUS OF 511629N 0014156W (NETHERAVON). ACFT MAY BE 
UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO 01449 728240. AR-2026-9718/01.
